name: February 14th
source:
A game I made for Angie, my theyfriend.

We're in Hogwarts, they being a gryffindor while I'm a slytherin.

[From [url=https://capriciousmoral.itch.io/february-14th]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
這是我為非二元性別伴侶安吉製作的一款遊戲。

我們身在霍格華茲，安吉屬於葛來分多，而我屬於史萊哲林。

[摘自[url=https://capriciousmoral.itch.io/february-14th]Itch.io[/url]]
